title: Dhugaa Baatota Bade
intro: Bara dheeraa darbe keessatti hawaasni tokko lafa qaxxaamuraa impaayera gidduu jiru keessa jiraata ture. Nabiyyiin isaanii gara daandii dhugaatti isaan waame, ta’us garuu kufrii fi cunqursaa irratti maxxanan. Seenaan kun adaba waaqaatiin xumurama. Saba kanaa fi hiree isaanii ragaalee armaan gadii irraa adda baasuu dandeessu?
clues: Ummanni tokko akeekkachiisa ergamtoota ofii keessaa tokkoon fide ni dide.
Ergamaan Rabbiin qofa gabbaruuf nu waamee malaammaltummaa irraa akeekkachiise.
Irra daddarbaan keenya raajii qajeelummaadhaan nu gidduutti ergame ganuu ture.
Adabbiin sun osoo mana keenya keessa nagaan jiraachaa jirruu nu gahe.
Nabiyyii keenya ganuu fi amantoota ari'achuu keenyaan diigamne.
arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
